metadata.title: Parabolic AI plays are now in 'no man's land' says Cramer - MarketWatch

content.text:
3 hours ago
Parabolic AI plays are now in 'no man's land' says Cramer
Jim Cramer, up early as usual, notes the sharp sell-off in U.S. equity-index futures, which is being led by further declines for popular AI-linked plays.
For example, shares of Advanced Micro Devices, up 273% over the last 12 months, are following yesterday's 6.5% slide with an additional 2% retreat in Wednesday's premarket action.
The CNBC contributor usually errs to the bullish side, but he's wary this morning, suggesting that because semiconductor and data-center buildout plays have had such "parabolic" moves this latest pullback leaves trends somewhat in limbo.
